text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Lead and lag compensation place the zero and pole in different orders

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Exact frequency responses of these illustrative compensators. Lead raises high-frequency gain relative to DC; lag lowers it. A separate gain factor may
restore a chosen crossover or increase low-frequency loop gain. Pole/zero placement alone does not guarantee a desired closed-loop margin.
